Hi ROSIO,

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How is it going? Believe it or not, September is almost here already! I hope you’re still fully enjoying the warm season as it comes to a close and that, like us, you’re just as excited to welcome the crisp air of fall, with its dazzling colors and, quite
 sadly, shorter days.

 

 For the iconic monarch butterflies that we made our company's mission to save from extinction , the arrival of fall is the trigger to begin their
 epic migration —traveling more than 4,000 miles south across the continent , all the way to the forests of northern Mexico and California.

 

 All summer long , we watched them peacefully as they flew, laid eggs, hatched, fed, formed their chrysalises, and emerged once again
 by the thousands in our vast milkweed fields —now serving as an 
emergency refuge for them at a time when, everywhere else, milkweed, the only host plant and food of their caterpillar,
 is being destroyed through pesticides, municipal mowing, and urban expansion on once-wild farmland.

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 As a token of thanks for this lifeline, the monarchs offer us an invaluable gift each year: tons of seed pods , born of their precious pollination work, filled with seeds and silky fibers whose many properties had long been forgotten —until
 quite recently!

 

 Milkweed fibers are naturally hollow (like polar bear hair), forming tiny tubes that trap air and create an
 exceptional thermal, acoustic, antibacterial and water-repellent barrier . Light yet highly insulating , they rival—or even
 surpass—synthetic and animal materials like Primaloft, goose down or merino wool,
 without the ecological or ethical cost. Coated in a natural wax, these fibers repel both rain and snow from the outside and moisture/sweat from the inside, keeping you warm and dry in all conditions, with thin clothes or accessories.

 

 We use these hollow fibers as the main insulation component in more than
30 products (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K3XGSA2BHZHWQEV1BEMRJRGQ_0) that we manufacture locally with partially automated equipment: 

 

 
 
 Some made for winter , like our popular mittens (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K3XGSA2BHZHWQEV1BEMRJRGQ_1), scarves (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K3XGSA2BHZHWQEV1BEMRJRGQ_2) ,
 neck warmers (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K3XGSA2BHZHWQEV1BEMRJRGQ_3) ,
 insoles (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K3XGSA2BHZHWQEV1BEMRJRGQ_4) and
 beanies (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K3XGSA2BHZHWQEV1BEMRJRGQ_5) that were tested and approved in the Arctic's freezing temperatures.

 Some made for summer and lifestyle, like our lunch bags (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K3XGSA2BHZHWQEV1BEMRJRGQ_6) and can cozies (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K3XGSA2BHZHWQEV1BEMRJRGQ_7) that use milkweed's tremendous insulating power to keep food and drinks fresh.
 

 

 Milkweed is a true, rare win-win for nature and humans. 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Every year around mid-September, we host an exclusive online event
 for our customers and newsletter subscribers: our Annual Fall Presale, where all products on
lasclay.com (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K3XGSA2BHZHWQEV1BEMRJRGQ_8) are up to 20% off for a limited time and while supplies last—and where we also unveil our much-awaited new milkweed products.

 

 This is a pretty good time to plan ahead—whether by choosing original, sustainable holiday gifts made with milkweed, or by getting your family ready for the cooler season. 

 

 It also helps us anticipate the strong demand more precisely ( in the past two years, we had to stop taking Christmas orders by the end of October ) while also
 ensuring the survival of our milkweed fields and the endangered monarchs that will rely on it next summer.

 

 Since you’ve subscribed to our newsletter or purchased milkweed seeds from us in the past, we guess this cause matters to you . Now that you’ve gotten to know us a little better, we’d love if you considered supporting this year’s Presale
 by trying one of our products. And even if you don’t need anything right now, simply sharing our story with friends and family helps our mission more than you can imagine!

 

 
 So in the next few weeks, please stay tuned for our upcoming emails with more details about the products , direct links to the presale collection, exclusive discount codes and more!
 To make sure you don’t miss a thing, we invite you to add hey@lasclay.com
 to your email contacts so our messages don’t end up in your spam folder .

 Thank you, once again, for helping us carry out our mission: making milkweed accessible through affordable, sustainable, efficient and well-crafted products —while contributing to the protection of monarch butterflies.
 Your support truly means a lot to us. 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
Warmly,

 
 Gabriel
